# Café Moka Dubai Mall

> Café Moka is a coffee-shop outlet at The Dubai Mall in Downtown Dubai. Opened in November 2008 at the foot of the Burj Khalifa, the mall holds more than 1,200 shops and around 120 restaurants and cafés across four retail levels, together with the Dubai Aquarium and an Olympic-sized ice rink. It is one of the world's most visited retail destinations, drawing over 100 million visits a year.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Downtown Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This project covered a Café Moka outlet at The Dubai Mall in Downtown Dubai, prepared for Quatro Group. MENASCO produced the design drawings for the café, developing the MEP design documentation needed to take the food and beverage unit forward into its fit-out, in line with the requirements of a major retail environment.
